# Justification coding: do stated reasons track the penalty?

*Generated by analysis/analyze_justifications.py from data/signal_openrouter_lowharm. Penalties in percent of scale; SESOI = 3%; brackets are 95% bootstrap CIs over matched pairs and samples. Judges: judge-gpt-6-luna, judge-deepseek-v4.1-flash. Each saw only the explanation text.*

## Judge agreement

- 1917 justifications coded by both judges. Detection role: agreement 96%, Cohen's kappa 0.93; raises vs. not: kappa 0.95. When both say raises, they agree on strength 92%.
- Agreement by subject model: or-claude-sonnet-5.5 99%, or-deepseek-v4-pro 92%, or-gemini-4-argon 100%, or-gpt-6.1-sol 94%
- Codes used: 1842 agreed, 0 adjudicated, 75 still disputed (left out of the tests; listed in analysis/output/<name>_disputes.md).
- No human codes yet (see --sheet).
